settings.heading: A little attention goes a long way.
settings.intro: Simple habits help your rug age beautifully.
settings.body: Vacuum gently and regularly, turn your rug periodically, and blot spills immediately with a clean, dry cloth. For anything more serious, contact a professional rug cleaner familiar with natural fibres.

settings.heading: Everyday care
settings.text: Use suction without a beater bar and take care around the edges and fringe.

settings.heading: Sun and furniture
settings.text: Rotate your rug and use protective pads to support even wear.

settings.heading: When in doubt
settings.text: Ask our team before using a product or treating a difficult mark.
